title: Plugins
description: Signed extensions that run in locked-down containers. Nothing third party loads until you trust its publisher and approve what it may do.
loadFailedHint: The plugin runtime needs a reachable Docker daemon. Check the control plane logs, then reload.

empty.title: No plugins installed
empty.description: Trust a publisher key first, then install a plugin package you obtained from them. See the plugins guide for the package format.

abilities.read: Receive the alert event being delivered (title, text, status, resource).
abilities.readSensitive: Also receive log excerpts attached to alerts, which can contain secrets.

approve.title: Approve {{name}}
approve.description: Review exactly what {{name}} {{version}} from {{publisher}} asks for. Nothing is granted until you tick it and approve.
approve.networkNone: No network. The plugin cannot reach anything outside its container.
approve.networkHosts: Declared hosts: {{hosts}}. These are shown for your review and are not yet enforced per host, so treat the plugin as able to reach the internet.
approve.never: Secrets are never stored by the plugin. The credential for a channel is sent with each delivery only.
approve.needsRead: Tick the read ability: a notification plugin cannot work without it.
approve.approved: {{name}} approved. Enable it to start it.

installDialog.title: Install a plugin
installDialog.description: Paste the manifest and signature from the publisher. Installing verifies them and records the package. It does not approve or start anything.
installDialog.manifestHint: Paste the file exactly as the publisher shipped it. Any edit breaks the signature.
installDialog.noKeys: No trusted keys yet. Add the publisher's key below first.
installDialog.digestHint: Refuse the install unless the image is pinned to exactly this sha256 digest.
installDialog.configHint: Non-secret settings only. Credentials go on the notification channel.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: The plugin is stopped and deleted. Notification channels that use it will stop delivering until you pick another channel kind.

keys.title: Trusted publisher keys
keys.description: Only packages signed by a key on this list can be installed. The list starts empty.
keys.emptyDescription: Nothing third party can be installed. Verify a publisher's key with them directly, then add it.
keys.name: Publisher name
keys.removeDescription: Plugins signed by this key stop at the next supervisor pass. They stay installed.
